Products

Each piece is crafted by hand using traditional methods. Natural materials, no shortcuts.

Brain-Tanned Deer Hide Pouch

A soft, supple pouch made from brain-tanned deer hide. Perfect for carrying fire-making tools, herbs, or small treasures. Each hide is processed by hand using only the animal's brain as a tanning agent — no chemicals, no shortcuts.

Oak Bark Tanned Belt

A sturdy belt tanned over several months using oak bark. This traditional vegetable-tanning method produces a rich, warm brown leather that deepens with age. Hand-stitched with waxed linen thread.

Bone Needle Set

A set of three hand-carved bone needles in different sizes, perfect for working with leather and sinew. Comes in a small leather roll. Each needle is shaped and polished from deer or cattle bone.
